Safety Considerations Read and follow manufacturer instructions carefully. Follow all local electrical codes during installation. All wiring must conform to local and national electrical codes. Improper wiring or installation may damage the thermostat and equipment. Recognize safety information. This is the safety-alert symbol . When you see this symbol on the equipment and in the instruction manual, be alert to the potential for personal injury. Understand the signal words DANGER, WARNING, and CAUTION. These words are used with the safety-alert symbol. DANGER identifies the most serious hazards which will result in severe personal injury or death. WARNING signifies a hazard which could result in personal

injury or death. CAUTION is used to identify unsafe practices which may result in minor personal injury or product and property damage. NOTE is used to highlight suggestions which will result in enhanced installation, reliability, or operation. This document defines the instructions needed to initiate the relearning process on the ecobee for Carrier/Bryant smart thermostats with InteliSense™ technology whenever one of the following equipment control boards is replaced. Table 1 – Equipment Boards Board P/N HK42FZ114 HK42FZ116 HK38EA060 HK38EA071 HK32EA013 Description Control Board - 1-STG InteliSense Furnace Control Board - 2-STG InteliSense Furnace Control Board - InteliSense Fan Coil (R-410A) *** Superseded by HK38EA071 *** Control Board - InteliSense Fan Coil (R-410A, R-454B) AC HP SCM NOTE: Please confirm that all the connectors to the control board are fully seated and that all sensors are properly connected. 2. Relearn Process To initiate the relearning process, follow the steps below. NOTE: The screens provided are for a 2-stage furnace control board, but the steps apply to all boards listed in Table 1. 2

2.1. ecobee3 lite (SKUs EB-STATE3LTICR-01, EB-STATE3LTICB-01, EB-STATELTIBR-01, EB-STATE3LTIBB-01) 1. From the Home screen, press the hamburger menu, to transition to the Main Menu System screen. Fig. 1 – Home Screen 3 A230178
2. From the Main Menu System screen, press the settings button which will launch the Main Menu General screen. Fig. 2 – Main Menu System Screen A230179 4
3. From the Main Menu General screen, select the Settings option to launch the Settings screen. Fig. 3 – Main Menu General Screen A230180 5
4. From the Settings screen, press the Installation Settings option. Fig. 4 – Settings Screen A230181 6
5. From this Installation Settings screen, press the Equipment option. Fig. 5 – Installation Settings Screen A230182 7

6. From the Equipment screen, press the Reconfigure Equipment option and follow the steps to define the equipment configuration. After completing these steps, return to the Home screen to begin the steps to learn the outdoor unit (if applicable). Fig. 6 – Equipment Screen 8 A230183
7. To continue the process, from the Home Screen, press the hamburger menu to transition to the Main Menu System screen. Fig. 7 – Home Screen A230178 9
8. From the Main Menu System screen, press the Settings button which will launch the Main Menu General screen. Fig. 8 – Main Menu System Screen A230179 10
9. From the Main Menu General screen, select the Settings option to launch the Settings screen. Fig. 9 – Main Menu General Screen A230180 11
10. From the Settings screen, press the Installation Settings option. Fig. 10 – System Screen A230181 12
11. From the Installation Settings screen, press the Test Equipment option. When the Warning screen is displayed, press OK. Fig. 11 – Test Equipment Option Screen A230309 13
Fig. 12 – Test Equipment Screen A230308 14

12. Based on the type of outdoor equipment installed, select the option that will engage the Y1 signal to turn on the outdoor unit's compressor. Run the test for approximately 10 seconds and then turn Off. Return to the Home screen to confirm the equipment has been relearned. A230310 Fig. 13 – Test Equipment Selector Screen A230312 15
13. To confirm the relearn process was successful, from the Home screen, press the hamburger menu, to transition to the Main Menu System screen. Fig. 14 – Home Screen 16 A230178
14. From the Main Menu System screen, press the Settings button which will launch the Main Menu General screen. Fig. 15 – Main Menu System Screen A230179 17
15. From the Main Menu General screen, select the System option. Fig. 16 – Main Menu General Screen A230186 18
16. From the System screen, select the Equipment option. Fig. 17 – System Screen A230187 19
17. The learned equipment will be displayed on the screen. Completing these steps will ensure equipment data is reported to the InteliSense cloud. Fig. 18 – Equipment Screen A230307 20
